tells: 1. Face close is a game-asset head: waxy uniform orange diffuse with no subsurface or pores, painted eyes with no wet specular or lid shadow, hard polygonal jaw and ear silhouette, and a dark halo where the depth-of-field blur meets the sharp head (club-4-face.png, centre head and the dark fringe along her left cheek and collar)

2. Background crowd is flat black cutout silhouettes with identical value and no rim, read as cardboard cards standing in haze, and they cut straight through the lit back wall (club-1-wide.png, middle band behind the front tables; club-3-mid.png, upper right)

3. Hair is solid helmet geometry with alpha-card bun spikes; no strands, no flyaways, no backlight transmission even with the warm stage spill behind them (club-2-mid.png, blondes at centre-left and right; club-6-held.png, back-row bun)

4. Candles light nothing: the red jar glows but the table tops, hands and faces next to them get no warm falloff, and the tables are untextured matte discs with no contact shadow under the jars or forearms (club-6-held.png, centre table and hands; club-2-mid.png, front tables)

5. Laugh onset in the strip is a stiff upper-body tilt and head turn with the hands glued to the table; mouths barely open, no shoulder shake, no breath, and the rest of the row holds dead still for a full second (club-5-strip.png, all six frames, green hoodie and white top)

1. Bodies don't sit in the seats: thighs float above the cushion and torsos hover in front of the seat backs with no compression, no contact shadow and no occlusion, so the front row reads as figures composited over a red bar (theatre-1-wide.png, front row lower half; theatre-3-mid.png, front row legs)

2. Face close has a black flat-shaded mouth interior with no teeth or tongue, glassy unfocused eyes, plastic skin with zero pore or sheen breakup, and dithered noise across the forehead (theatre-4-face.png, mouth and eyes)

3. Uniform lighting with no source logic: every person in the stalls is lit the same flat key regardless of depth, the back rows fade to cut-outs with hard dark outlines, and a blue lens dot floats in the haze (theatre-1-wide.png, upper two thirds; theatre-2-mid.png, top right)

4. Hair is shell geometry with a stippled dithered alpha fringe that crawls; buns and short crops look like moulded plastic and one figure wears a grey dithered cap of noise (theatre-3-mid.png, front right head; theatre-6-held.png, blonde bun centre-right)

5. Several faces repeat across the stalls (same green-shirt and teal-hoodie models visible in multiple rows), and in the strip the laugh is a synchronised head-drop with near-identical poses and arms clamped to knees (theatre-1-wide.png, rows 2 and 3; theatre-5-strip.png, t=12.6 to 13.0)

1. Hair edge on the face close is a dithered staircase of pixels with a blocky ear and a sharp CG silhouette against a smeared background, plus a dark matte line around the shoulder where focus changes (openmic-4-face.png, right side of the head and the collar edge)

2. Seated people have no chairs or contact under them in the wide: legs end in darkness, knees float, and the front row is a stack of torsos with no floor, no shadow and no chair legs (openmic-1-wide.png, lower third)

3. Skin across the crowd is one orange-pink tone with a flat specular sheen and no subsurface; forearms are near-white and texture-flat, and the glasses on the brown-haired woman are a painted outline (openmic-2-mid.png, arms of the green-top woman and the glasses woman; openmic-6-held.png, right edge arm)

4. Room is an empty box: a row of identical bloom-blob downlights on a featureless wall, no stage spill direction on the faces, and the people are lit evenly front-on as if by a camera headlamp (openmic-3-mid.png, wall and lights; openmic-1-wide.png, whole frame)

5. Motion is better (head turns toward neighbours, mouths open) but hands stay locked on knees, shoulders never shake, and heads swivel on rigid necks with no secondary motion in hair or clothing (openmic-5-strip.png, green-top woman and glasses woman, t=12.4 to 13.0)
